title: Day surgery appointment scheduling with patient preferences and stochastic operation duration.
problem: The paper addresses the problem of day surgery scheduling with patient preferences and limited operation rooms, aiming to increase operation efficiency and reduce surgery costs.
contribution: A multiple objective stochastic programming model and a multi-objective genetic algorithm are proposed to address day surgery scheduling with patient preferences and stochastic operation durations.
method: A multi-objective genetic algorithm is designed to solve a multiple objective stochastic programming model.
results: The proposed model and algorithm provide a feasible solution for maximizing individual preference of surgeons and improving operation room utilization.
